howToJoin.title: How to Become a Verified Driver
howToJoin.subtitle: Get verified in 4 simple steps and receive your official OTOX QR kit.

steps.title: Submit Basic Details
steps.description: Enter your name, phone number, vehicle registration number, and city.

steps.title: Verify Credentials
steps.description: Submit your valid commercial Driving License (DL) and Auto Registration Certificate (RC).

steps.title: Receive Your OTOX QR Kit
steps.description: Collect your weatherproof, tamper-resistant OTOX QR sticker and official Driver ID.

steps.title: Stick QR & Start Verifying
steps.description: Place the QR inside your auto so passengers can scan and verify every trip.

driverFaq.q: Does OTOX charge a commission on my passenger fare?
driverFaq.a: No. OTOX is a ride verification and trust platform—you collect 100% of your normal street or meter fare directly from the passenger.

driverFaq.q: What documents are needed to register?
driverFaq.a: You need a valid commercial Auto Driving License (DL), Vehicle Registration Certificate (RC), and government ID (Aadhaar / Voter ID) for KYC.
Once documents are submitted, our verification team typically completes approval within 24 to 48 hours.

driverFaq.q: What if my QR sticker gets damaged?
driverFaq.a: You can request a free replacement QR sticker anytime through support channel.
